To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
(1) The efficiency of the device is determined by the quality of the material and the quality of the interface between the material and the device.

the efficiency of a solar cell is a result of the interactions between charge carriers and defects and that these interactions are dependent on the device structure, the material properties, and the processing history.

(i) the presence of oxygen vacancies in the CdTe absorber is detrimental to the efficiency of the solar cell and (ii) the presence of a high concentration of oxygen in the CdTe/CdS interface is beneficial for device operation.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the characterization of defects and the interaction of defects with charge carriers.
the characterization of defects and their impact on PV device performance.
the characterization of photovoltaic devices and the determination of the role of defects in limiting device efficiency.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the characterization of defects in PV devices is necessary to understand the relationship between device efficiency and defect structure and concentration.
the most effective way to characterize PV devices is through a combination of macroscopic measurements, microscopic imaging, and atomic level characterization.
defects in photovoltaic devices are the primary limiting factor in device efficiency.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have demonstrated a new method to determine the minority carrier lifetime in the bulk of silicon wafers.
we have developed a new technique for determining the minority carrier lifetime in the base of a solar cell.
we have developed a set of techniques for the analysis of defects in photovoltaic materials.
The main takeaway from our work is that

defects in the bulk of a device are not the limiting factor in the efficiency of the device and the limiting factor in device efficiency is likely the interface between the semiconductor and the metal.
there is a strong correlation between defects and device performance.
there is a strong relationship between the atomic structure and the macroscopic properties of a device.
